blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.why: **достава́ть** — to reach, to touch. Wiktionary: доста́ть + -ва́ть.
**удава́ться** — to turn out well, to be a success. Wiktionary: уда́ться + -ва́ть.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to stop, to cease, to quit
to turn out well, to be a success
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: перестава́ть — to stop, to cease, to quit; покрыва́ть — to cover; достава́ть — to reach, to touch; удава́ться — to turn out well, to be a success.
**передава́ть** — to hand over, to deliver, to give. Wiktionary: переда́ть + -ва́ть.
**признава́ть** — to recognize (to acknowledge the existence or legality of something). Wiktionary: призна́ть + -ва́ть.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to hand over, to deliver, to give
to recognize (to acknowledge the existence or legality of something)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: продава́ть — to sell; передава́ть — to hand over, to deliver, to give; признава́ть — to recognize (to acknowledge the existence or legality of something); устава́ть — to get tired.
**скрыва́ть** — to hide, to conceal. Wiktionary: скрыть + -ва́ть.
**расстава́ться** — to part, to separate. Wiktionary: расста́ться + -ва́ть.
**придава́ть** — to give, to impart; to attach. Wiktionary: прида́ть + -ва́ть.
